violated_contract: A client-controlled query parameter interpolated into server-rendered HTML markup or attribute context must be percent-encoded (URL context) or HTML-escaped (text context) at the interpolation site: a raw value containing a double quote breaks out of the attribute (reflected XSS on an unauthenticated route), and a bare '&' or '#' corrupts the query handed to the next hop. omi-twitter-app's /auth/callback error branch interpolated the OAuth state param raw into the retry href and the setup page interpolated uid raw into its href (issue #14350).
canonical_prevention: Every plugin page that reflects a query parameter into markup encodes the value once at the reflection site, and a manifest-registered hermetic suite drives the real handlers through hostile values (quotes, script tags, ampersands, fragments) asserting the encoded form and the intact link.
